title: microtask ledger: vendor invoices + redlines (AM run)
content:
AM run notes - quick hits

Goal: clear 30m of microtasks before standup. low cognitive load items only.

Inbox / first pass (ordered by quickness)
- [ ] Invoice 2026-03-02 / Hegemont Labs: check PO match + tax line. vendor says 2% early pay. confirm GL code then forward to AP. (PR sent: jira JIRA-8123)
- [ ] Chase overdue invoice: BakerData (inv# BK-4531). Vendor flagged as urgent on Slack thread. Draft message: 'we received partial payment; need remittance. Can you confirm payment id and ETA?'
- [ ] Credit memo request from RMD Group — reconcile against March statement, note to attach credit memo PDF.
- [ ] Add invoice hold tag for vendor: 'contract-redline-pending' (prevents auto-pay)

Contract redline queue (quick triage)
- Redline packet: Redwood-Consulting-Statement-v2.docx (attached in drive link in thread). Key ask: shorten indemnity carveout and add 12-month auto-renew opt-out. 3 spots where legal wants alternate language; mark up and pass back.
  * Quick decision points (can do in this pass):
    - Replace 'sole and exclusive remedy' with 'exclusive remedy to the extent permitted by law' (one-liner tweak)
    - Remove 'mutual waiver of consequential damages' — flagged by SRE (too broad)
    - Add a 30-day supplier cure window for SLA breaches
- [ ] Prep short email to solutions-eng (Ravi) asking if 30-day cure is acceptable operationally. Keep language: 'propose 30-day cure; will require logging of incidents for audit.'

Renewals & reminders (calendar actions)
- [ ] Renewal: DataCache (contract exp 2026-04-02). Trigger: final renewal notice to account manager + update renewal sheet. Owner: Clara to confirm negotiation cadence.
- [ ] Mark renewal: 'send reminder 30d before; escalate 14d' in renewal tracker (spreadsheet cell: row 42).

Micro calculations / cost check (scratch)
- Hegemont Labs invoice: $9,812.50 net; 2% early pay = $196.25 discount -> payable $9,616.25 if paid before 2026-03-20. If hold flagged, cannot auto-capture discount. Decision: if cashflow positive, accept; else hold.
- BakerData partial: Payment shows $12,000 received on 2026-03-05; outstanding $3,500. Need remittance id to allocate.

Phone / vendor script (for quick call)
- Intro: 'Hey, Maya from Redwood finance — quick 2-min about invoice BK-4531.'
- Ask: 'We see partial payment; can you confirm remittance/reference? Also any dispute items we should know about? If not, can you push through remaining $3,500 by EOD next Tue?'
- Note: escalate if vendor mentions product issue -> loop in Customer Success (tag @clara).

Notes to self (things to log after tasks)
- record actions in 'vendor-ops-daily-log' sheet (link in linked_artifacts)
- add short status update to #finance-ops standup: 3 items cleared, 2 redlines in progress

Unresolved questions / follow-ups
- Confirm whether Redwood Dedicated customers are allowed to pass-through certain contractor terms (security exceptions). If yes, add clause template. Owner: legal (Clara)
- Do we have a standing PO with Hegemont? If not, ask procurement to raise ASAP. (ticket: PROP-1290)

Quick file tidy (10m)
- Move scanned credit memos into folder: shared_drives/company/misc/credit-memos/2026-Q1
- Rename 'Hegemont_invoice_030226.pdf' -> 'heg-inv-20260302-PO284.pdf'

Bottomline priorities for the morning (only these):
1) Hegemont: verify GL and tag hold if PO mismatch (15m)
2) BakerData: send chase message + log (10m)
3) Draft 3-line email to Ravi about redline cure window (5m)

Timeboxing: 30 minutes total.

Status snapshot (to paste in standup)
- Cleared: invoice triage x1 (small), updated ledger rows
- In-progress: contract redline packet (1 doc)
- Blocked: credit memo scan (waiting for vendor PDF)

End of AM run. Save this doc as 'microtask-ledger-maya-sahu' and append midday notes below after lunch.

-- midday addendum (2026-03-13 13:05) --
- [x] Sent BakerData chase (copied CS).
- [ ] Hegemont GL code still outstanding; pinged procurement.
- [ ] Received preliminary redline responses from Ravi — need to integrate into doc and run by legal by EOD.

-- quick log snippets to preserve context --
- Slack reference: https://redwoodworkspace.slack.com/archives/C0456JKL (thread: vendor-billing)
- Payment portal: Stripe payout id: ch_3KjZ0HJk2 (use in allocation)
- Reminder: check tax calc roundings, some vendors send 2-decimal truncation; reconcile to cents.
